sentences.text: Rannikon Sähkö- ja Kylmäasennus Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-21 under the industry code 43210, electrical installation.
First sales are recorded on 2026-09-21, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-10-02.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a coastal word but the registered industry is electrical installation.
